hardware: Intel Core i7-12700H, 16 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 3060 Laptop 6 GB, HP performance mode, plugged in

proposals.statement: Parents need a single place to see what they owe, their child's reports, and school notices, and to report their child's sickness

evidence.quote: One place where a parent can see what they owe, their child's reports and the school's notices, and tell us when their child is sick.

proposals.statement: The school wants to stop printing fee statements and reports to save costs and admin time

evidence.quote: And for us to stop printing. That's a real cost, and a lot of hours.

proposals.statement: The portal must provide the current balance, monthly fee statement as PDF, and EFT reference for parents to pay fees

evidence.quote: The current balance, the monthly statement as a PDF, and the reference to use for EFT.

proposals.statement: The portal must deliver term reports as PDFs on the same day for all parents, without early access

evidence.quote: The term report as a PDF, the same one we print. Released on the same day for everyone.

proposals.statement: Current system prints fee statements and reports, but half the parents never receive them due to delivery issues

evidence.quote: Fee statements are printed every month and sent home in the learners' bags, and half of them never reach the parents.

proposals.statement: Current system uses WhatsApp broadcast lists for notices, but parents who change numbers fall off the list

evidence.quote: Those go on WhatsApp broadcast lists, and by email. But a broadcast list fills up, so we have five of them now, and parents who change their numbers just fall off.

proposals.statement: Current system relies on handwritten absence notes in homework diaries or emails, leading to missing absence records

evidence.quote: Handwritten in the learner's homework diary, or an email to the class teacher, who may or may not pass it on to the office. We had a learner marked absent for three days last term and nobody at the office knew why.

proposals.statement: SchoolBase 7, a system from about 2014, runs on a server in the admin block and holds learners, parents, fees, and marks

evidence.quote: On a server in the admin block. It's SchoolBase 7, from about 2014 I think. It holds the learners, the parents, fees and marks.

proposals.statement: The portal must be lightweight with small pages and PDFs only downloaded when opened to accommodate low data usage

evidence.quote: So the portal has to be light: small pages, and the PDFs only downloaded when someone actually opens one.

proposals.statement: The portal must be zero-rated by the network to support bursary families with limited data

evidence.quote: Yes. And could it be zero-rated? I heard some schools have arranged that with the networks.

proposals.statement: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see their records, with exceptions for court-ordered access for divorced parents

evidence.quote: These are children's records. Reports, the medical reasons on absence notes, family addresses. Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see anything about that learner.

proposals.statement: The portal must respect restrictions per parent, and the office must be able to set them

evidence.quote: The portal has to respect restrictions per parent, and the office has to be able to set them.

proposals.statement: The data must be hosted in South Africa as per the board's decision

evidence.quote: The board said it must be hosted in South Africa. That came out of the last board meeting.

proposals.statement: The portal should use the school's maroon color instead of generic blue

evidence.quote: Oh, and please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue.

proposals.statement: The portal should support isiZulu for notices and main screens to accommodate grandparents who are more comfortable in isiZulu

evidence.quote: English is the school's language, but a lot of our grandparents look after the children, and they're more comfortable in isiZulu. If the notices and the main screens could be in isiZulu too, that would mean a lot.

proposals.statement: The portal must have big, clear text and be accessible to screen readers for parents with visual impairments

evidence.quote: And big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the PTA who uses a screen reader.

proposals.statement: The portal must respect parent restrictions set by the office and host data within South Africa

evidence.quote: the portal has to respect restrictions per parent, and the office has to be able to set them
The board said it must be hosted in South Africa

proposals.statement: The portal must support isiZulu language for notices and main screens, and have large, clear text for accessibility

evidence.quote: English is the school's language, but a lot of our grandparents look after the children, and they're more comfortable in isiZulu. If the notices and the main screens could be in isiZulu too, that would mean a lot
big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the PTA who uses a screen reader. Oh, and please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue

proposals.statement: The finance committee has proposed 250,000 rand for the first year, but the board must approve it by January 28

evidence.quote: The finance committee has proposed two hundred and fifty thousand rand for the first year, all in. But the board has to approve it, and they only meet on the twenty-eighth of January

proposals.statement: The portal should allow parents to receive term two reports by June 26

evidence.quote: The term two reports go out on the twenty-sixth of June. We'd like parents to get those through the portal

proposals.statement: The school has 1,650 parent contacts, with many families having both parents and grandparents listed

evidence.quote: Ayanda, I've just looked in SchoolBase while we were talking. It's not fourteen hundred parent contacts, it's about sixteen hundred and fifty. A lot of families have both parents and a grandparent listed

proposals.statement: If the first report day goes poorly, parents may lose trust in the portal immediately

evidence.quote: A risk I see is that if the first report day goes badly, parents lose trust in the portal straight away

proposals.statement: The portal will start with a trial for grade eight term one reports in April

evidence.quote: Let's do grade eight in April as the trial
Agreed, grade eight first

proposals.statement: The school has only one IT person who works two days a week, so there's no one to fix issues during report nights

evidence.quote: Me, honestly. I'm the only IT person, and only two days a week. If something breaks on report night, there's nobody

proposals.statement: Booking slots for parents' evenings is planned for later but not for the first version

evidence.quote: Eventually, booking slots for parents' evenings. But not now
